title: Antenna
text: 对天线或天线阵列建模，考虑入射功率波 (RX) 和辐射功率波 (TX)，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Antenna Gain} 指定天线增益 0；{Source of antenna model} 指定天线模型 Isotropic、{Create Antenna} 打开 Antenna Toolbox 的 Antenna Designer 应用、{Antenna object} 指定来自工作区的天线或阵列元素输入 antenna catalog、{Impedance (Ohm)} 指定输入阻抗、{Input incident wave} 用于模拟接收天线的输入入射波、{Output radiated wave} 用于发射天线的输出辐射波、{Incident carrier frequencies} 指定接收信号的载波频率、{Radiated carrier frequencies} 指定发射信号的载波频率、{Direction of departure} 输出信号功率波辐射所朝向的方位角和仰角、{Direction of arrival} 指定输入信号功率波到达所对应的方位角和仰角、{Simulate noise} 指定模拟热噪声、{Ground and hide negative terminals} 指定 RF 电路端子接地、{Modeling options} 指定对频率相关天线参数建模 Time、{Relative error desired (dB)} 指定有理拟合可接受的相对误差、{Automatically estimate impulse response duration} 指定自动计算冲激响应、{Impulse response duration} 指定冲激响应持续时间 1e-10，按实例取值。

ports.name: RX
ports.summary: 接收信号 scalar | vector | matrix | m -by- n -by- k array

ports.name: TX
ports.summary: 发射信号 scalar | vector | matrix | m -by- n -by- k array

params.name: Source of antenna model
params.values: 天线模型 Isotropic radiator (default) | Antenna Designer | Antenna object

params.name: Create Antenna
params.values: 打开 Antenna Toolbox 的 Antenna Designer 应用 button

params.name: Antenna object
params.values: 来自工作区的天线或阵列元素输入 antenna catalog object | antenna array catalog object | measuredAntenna object | pcbstack object

params.name: Antenna Gain
params.values: 天线增益 0 dBi (default) | real scalar or vector | positive scalar or vector

params.name: Impedance (Ohm)
params.values: 输入阻抗 50 (default) | complex-valued scalar or vector

params.name: Input incident wave
params.values: 用于模拟接收天线的输入入射波 ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Output radiated wave
params.values: 用于发射天线的输出辐射波 ’on’ (default) | ’off’

params.name: Incident carrier frequencies
params.values: 接收信号的载波频率 2.1 GHz (default) | nonnegative scalar or row vector

params.name: Radiated carrier frequencies
params.values: 发射信号的载波频率 2.1 GHz (default) | nonnegative scalar or row vector

params.name: Direction of departure
params.values: 输出信号功率波辐射所朝向的方位角和仰角 [0 0] deg (default) | finite real row vector of length 1-by-2 | finite real matrix of length m -by-2

params.name: Direction of arrival
params.values: 输入信号功率波到达所对应的方位角和仰角 [180 0] deg (default) | finite real row vector of length 1-by-2 | finite real matrix of length m -by-2

params.name: Modeling options
params.values: 对频率相关天线参数建模 Time domain (default) | Frequency domain

params.name: Relative error desired (dB)
params.values: 有理拟合可接受的相对误差 -40 (default) | scalar

params.name: Impulse response duration
params.values: 冲激响应持续时间 1e-10 s (default) | scalar
